body: Compatibility markers removed: present-gate no longer renders Gate review and Decision markers still required by supported Claude/Codex gate-guardrail assertions.
Unbound legacy gates cannot render the required snapshot because the canonical field requires a bound Briefing identity and digest.
The automatic reviewer-REJECTED branch enters feedback routing before loading the deferred gate lifecycle, and the structural test does not verify that ordering.
The root-review extractors bracket on narrated Committed text instead of successful state-commit completion events, so presentation before durable binding can pass.
Captain natural-language mappings lack runtime scenarios; the not-yet control supplies the canonical hold decision directly.
The primary first-workflow onboarding page retains the old gate-review example and contradicts the new six-field presenter and concepts page.
